comment: Golden vectors for gateway-api/v2 Payload Size. Build each payload from its construction and length, confirm its SHA-256, and apply the topic's maximum, or the configured maximum when one is given, before anything else: the verdict is admitted, payload_too_large, or configuration_refused for a configured maximum above the table or below the floor.

cases.name: gateway_health_at_maximum
cases.note: exactly the maximum

cases.name: gateway_health_one_over
cases.note: one byte over the maximum

cases.name: gateway_health_four_times
cases.note: refused without reading past the length

cases.name: gateway_health_invalid_utf8_one_over
cases.note: size is decided before the Payload Member Rule's invalid_unicode

cases.name: gateway_health_configured_half_at
cases.note: a configured lower maximum admits a payload at it

cases.name: gateway_health_configured_half_over
cases.note: a configured lower maximum refuses a conforming payload above it

cases.name: gateway_health_configured_above_table
cases.note: configuration may lower a maximum, never raise it

cases.name: gateway_health_configured_below_floor
cases.note: configuration never lowers a maximum below the floor
